from pathlib import Path
import os,signal,subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
base='48c1c8dc12abae84a349548f50f64bd48f7691ed'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base or git('rev-parse','origin/main')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
target=repo/'tools/ats_review_smoke.py'
if target.exists():raise SystemExit('TARGET_EXISTS')
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
target.write_text('''"""No-submit ATS fixture Review gate. Does not prove live ATS readiness."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TEST = "tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py"
PATTERNS = (
    "adapter_reaches_review_with_required_fields_and_upload",
    "submit_requires_gate_b",
    "review_requires_a_final_submit_control",
)

def main() -> int:
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "--tb=short", TEST,
               "-k", " or ".join(PATTERNS)]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        rc = proc.wait(timeout=300)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=8)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            proc.wait()
        print("ATS_FIXTURE_REVIEW_GATE=TIMEOUT; LIVE_REVIEW=NOT_VERIFIED; SUBMISSIONS=NOT_ATTEMPTED", flush=True)
        return 124
    print(f"ATS_FIXTURE_REVIEW_GATE={'PASS' if rc == 0 else 'FAIL'}; LIVE_REVIEW=NOT_VERIFIED; SUBMISSIONS=NOT_ATTEMPTED", flush=True)
    return rc

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
''')
def run(args,timeout):
 p=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=timeout)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=8)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);o,e=p.communicate()
  print('TIMEOUT',args,o[-2600:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(124)
 print('RESULT',args,p.returncode,o[-3500:],e[-800:],flush=True)
 return p.returncode,o
rc,out=run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(target)],350)
if rc or 'ATS_FIXTURE_REVIEW_GATE=PASS' not in out:raise SystemExit('SMOKE_FAILED')
rc,_=run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1','tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py'],360)
if rc:raise SystemExit('REGRESSION_FAILED')
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tools/ats_review_smoke.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','tools: add no-submit ATS review fixture smoke gate'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH',git('rev-parse','HEAD'),flush=True)
